description: This file defines the MembershipAPI class which provides REST API endpoints for managing Membership entities, including CRUD operations such as get, list, create, update, and delete. It leverages various core API components, validation rules, and service layers within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: MembershipAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing Membership entities in the HRM system, supporting CRUD operations with validation and service layer interactions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Membership entity by ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all Membership entities with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Membership entity based on request data.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Saves (creates or updates) a Membership entity with provided data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Membership entity identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more Membership entities based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rule for fetching a single Membership by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for listing Memberships with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for creating a Membership.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating a Membership.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Defines validation rules for deleting Memberships.
